body:
commit 552bd39 (GFD), apps2/mud/hot_reload.go. watchForReloadSignal() listens for SIGHUP and re-invokes itemdefReg.LoadFile/mobDropReg.LoadFile on the live process, no restart. Chosen over an in-game command since this MUD has no admin/GM role concept in its command dispatch -- a signal only reaches someone with shell access already. Live-verified: kill -HUP <mud-pid> logs '[hot-reload] data/items.json reloaded' / '[hot-reload] data/mob_drops.json reloaded'.

⚓ ☃
title: S412-05/S412-10: hot reload for data/items.json and data/mob_drops.json via SIGHUP
